summaries.title: LLM-Powered Grapheme-to-Phoneme Conversion: Benchmark and Case Study
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于评测基准与数据集。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **LLM-Powered Grapheme-to-Phoneme Conversion** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we evaluate the performance of LLMs in G2P conversion and introduce prompting and post-processing methods that enhance LLM outputs without additional training...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We also present a benchmarking dataset designed to assess G2P performance on sentence-level phonetic challenges of the Persian language。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our results show that by applying the proposed methods, LLMs can outperform traditional G2P tools, even in an underrepresented language like Persian, highlighting the potential of...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 3 赞），本工作可作为评估 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
